after.description: Only return memories created after this ISO date

before.description: Only return memories created before this ISO date

context.description: Retrieval context - memories encoded in matching context get boosted

mood.description: Current mood - boosts recall of memories encoded in similar emotional state

query.description: Search query to match against memories

retrieval.description: Retrieval strategy. hybrid is the default (vector + FTS/BM25 fusion); vector bypasses FTS for lower latency but loses lexical exact-match signal.

scope.description: agent restricts recall to this MCP server agent identity. shared searches the whole store. Defaults to shared for backward compatibility.

sources.description: Only return episodic memories from these sources

tags.description: Only return episodic memories with these tags
